success_gates: Every case is evaluated in a newly launched Python process.
The untampered persisted bundle returns PARTIAL with only physical_plan_execution unverified.
Tampering with the independent observation, certificate, or persisted approval manifest is rejected.
claim_boundary: Process separation prevents reliance on shared in-memory Planner or Certificate Builder objects.
Persisted files are independently loaded and schema validated by the Checker entry point.
This experiment does not create a cryptographic trust anchor or attest DuckDB-internal execution.
